name: Concrete and Orange
description: Bauhaus and the Swiss International Style: concrete grey paper with a fine dot grid, ink-black 900-weight headings, solid orange geometry (discs, bars), black-bordered cards with an orange left edge, monospace furniture. Keywords are not italic; they simply turn orange.

ink.use: primary text, black borders; background of inverted pages

accent.use: the only accent: discs, bars, keywords, card left edges, nodes

display.family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Source Han Sans TC', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

body.family: 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Source Han Sans TC', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
